correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md gives the natural C2 spline interior-curvature matrix with determinant (r+2)(3r+2)>0 and piecewise cubic formula. Telescoping jump data into three unit steps exactly attains the operator seminorm on a step. Central and outer step excursions have respectively C(r)=1+8/(3 sqrt(3) r(r+2)) and O(r)=1+2 F_r(q(r))+4r/[3 sqrt(3)(r+2)(3r+2)]. Differentiating the rational F_r confirms the displayed positive derivative polynomial. The proof controls the remaining derivative term by q(r)∈(1/3,1-1/sqrt(3)); C strictly decreases and O strictly increases, with opposite endpoint behaviors, proving a unique global symmetric minimax. Independent sympy exact derivative identity and numerical root solve give r*=1.428825530629474 and gain=1.3142559547735972. The package checker source was read (exact Fraction interval arithmetic and finite critical-point variation testing); the infinite result relies on the analytic step and monotonicity argument, not that finite stress test.
